description: Creates a copy of an assistant with the same settings (phone numbers are not copied). Post-call actions (external webhooks, automatic call-backs) are NOT copied unless copy_actions is true. ALWAYS copied, whatever copy_actions says: webhook_url (call events) and metadata.custom_functions (webhooks the assistant calls during a call). The reply lists copied actions and these always-copied endpoints by host only.

agent_id.description: The assistant id. Call call2me_list_agents first if unknown.

copy_actions.description: Also copy post_call_actions. Ask the user first; default false.

name: call2me_duplicate_agent
title: Duplicate assistant
